uncertain: Label-to-pad mapping inferred for J8, J2, J10, J4 and J5: the silkscreen prints each connector's names as a separate column list in a box beside the connector, with no lines or numbers tying a name to a pad; assumed the list order left-to-right matches the pads left-to-right.

J4 list order (GND,3V3,NC,IO38 | GND,3V3,IO19-SDA,IO20-SCL) is the mirror of the separate J2 and J8 lists, so the assumed left-to-right correspondence on J4 (and on the 4-pin connectors) may be reversed.
J4 is drawn as one 8-pad connector outline with one designator but has two function captions (GPIO_D under the left four pads, I2C under the right four); transcribed as one connector.
J1 (BAT) was skipped as a battery-only connector, but it carries polarity marks ('+' beside the lower pad and a bar mark near the upper pad) that could count as individual pin labels.
Position 1 taken as the right end of each top-edge row and of J5 because USB-C J3 is on the right edge, although J3 is not in line with these rows.
notes: PCB render, silkscreen 'ESP32 Display-5 Inch SKU:DIS07050H', 'V2.0', www.elecrow.com. Combined names such as 'IO20-SCL' split into label IO20 plus function SCL; slashed zeros (IO20, RX0, TX0) read as 0. Skipped per rule 1: J3 USB-C (UART0, with nearby GND/5V text not tied to individual pins), J1 BAT battery connector, JP1 40-pin and J6 10-pin FPC connectors (only end numbers 1/40 and 1/10 printed, pins not individually labeled), SD1 TF card slot, U2 module pads, BOOT/RESET buttons, PWR LED. The I2S-CTRL / IO18-I2S-LRCLK / IO42-I2S-BCLK / IO17-I2S-SDIN box beside amplifier U11 describes internal connections, not a wiring point.
